Interested in discussing RNA modeling, machine learning, teaching, or a possible collaboration? I'd be glad to hear from you.

Whether you have a research question, see a connection between our work, or simply want to exchange ideas, feel free to write. Messages from students and early-career researchers are also very welcome.

## Email

The best way to reach me is by email:

[gkulemeyer@sinc.unl.edu.ar](mailto:gkulemeyer@sinc.unl.edu.ar){.contact-primary}
